hero.lead: Our joinery is designed for insulation, durability and a design that stands out.
hero.item1Text: Internal chambers slow the flow of heat through the frame.
hero.item2Text: Sealed panes separated by a spacer reduce heat loss.
hero.item3Text: Seals the joint between sash and frame against air and water.

energy.title: Thermal performance you notice on the bill and in the room.
energy.lead: Good joinery is judged by what it saves and how it feels, not only by how it looks.
energy.chambersText: Internal air chambers slow heat transfer between interior and exterior.
energy.heatText: Less energy lost in winter, less heat gained in summer.
energy.acousticText: Glazing and seals that attenuate exterior noise.
energy.airtightText: Continuous gaskets and quality hardware for a precise closure.
energy.note: Performance values depend on the selected system and glazing. Technical data sheets are available on request.

about.lead: Winex supplies PVC, aluminium and timber joinery. We work to order, verify quality at each stage and supply directly from the factory yard.
about.story1: Our offer is built around three materials — PVC, aluminium and timber — so every project receives the solution that suits it, not merely the one that happens to be available.
about.story2: By working directly with the factory and supplying straight from the factory yard, we keep specification, lead times and quality under close control.
about.precisionText: Every element is specified to size, with tight tolerances and checks along the way.
about.efficiencyText: We treat joinery as a system that saves energy, not only as a product.
about.craftText: Modern technology combined with the experience of people who know the material.
about.reliabilityText: Clear communication, realistic lead times and support before and after installation.

blocks.p: The controller of personal data is **{identity}**.

ul: **Contact and quote request forms:** name, email, phone (optional), message content and the language of the page. Purpose: replying to your request and preparing a quote. Legal basis: pre-contractual steps at your request and our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR).

**Newsletter:** email address and language. Purpose: sending commercial communications. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you may withdraw at any time. Subscription uses double confirmation: you receive an email with a confirmation link and no communications are sent until you confirm. Unconfirmed requests are deleted automatically after 30 days; we keep the confirmation date as proof of consent.

**Anonymous site statistics:** pages visited, clicks on buttons and links, device type, country, language and traffic source. We use no cookies and store nothing on your device. The visitor identifier is an anonymous code recalculated every day that cannot be used to identify you. We respect the “Do Not Track” and “Global Privacy Control” signals. Purpose: understanding and improving the site. Legal basis: legitimate interest. Detailed events are deleted after 3 days; only aggregate totals remain.
**Technical data:** your IP address is used temporarily for security and abuse prevention (rate limiting). Legal basis: legitimate interest.

**Spam and bot protection:** the contact form uses a signed, time-limited security token, a hidden trap field and rate limiting by IP address (kept only in memory, for a short time). If enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile checks that the request comes from a person. Legal basis: legitimate interest in keeping the website and our mailbox safe.

blocks.p: Data is processed by service providers acting as processors:

ul: Convex, Inc. — storage of messages, subscribers and anonymous statistics;
Resend, Inc. — sending and delivery of emails;
Cloudflare, Inc. — Turnstile anti-bot check on the contact form, only if enabled;
OneSpec — only if you use the online configurator, under its own policy.

blocks.p: Some providers may process data outside the European Economic Area; transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses and/or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, as applicable.

Contact messages: up to 24 months from the last interaction, unless a contract is concluded. Newsletter: until you withdraw consent. Data arising from contractual relationships: as required by law (including accounting and tax obligations).

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and the right to withdraw consent. You can write to us at {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority or with the Romanian [National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP)](https://www.dataprotection.ro).
We use encrypted connections (HTTPS), restricted access to data and technical measures against abuse. We do not sell your data.
We may update this policy; the current version is always the one published on this page.
This website ({domain}) is operated by **{identity}**. By using the website you accept these terms.

The content of this website is for information only and does not constitute a binding offer. Images, colours and specifications may differ from the final product. Offers and contracts are agreed individually, in writing.

Configurations created with the configurator are indicative until the offer is confirmed in writing by Winex. The configurator is provided in cooperation with OneSpec; its use may also be subject to that provider’s terms.
Texts, images, logos and the design of this website belong to Winex or its licensors and may not be copied or used without written permission.

We make every effort to keep the information accurate, but we do not guarantee that it is free of errors or that the website is available without interruption. Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.
The processing of personal data is described in the [Privacy Policy](internal:/privacy) and the [Cookie Policy](internal:/cookies).

These terms are governed by Romanian law. Consumers may also have recourse to the [ANPC alternative dispute resolution (SAL)](https://anpc.ro/ce-este-sal/) and to the courts and consumer bodies of their country of residence.

You may not use the website or its forms to send spam, malicious code or unlawful content, to run automated submissions, or to try to disrupt or gain unauthorised access to the service. Such requests are blocked, and we may report abuse to the competent authorities.
Cookies are small files stored in your browser, used to operate and improve a website.

The website **does not currently use analytics or marketing cookies**. We measure visits with our own system, without cookies and without storing information on your device (details in the [Privacy Policy](internal:/privacy)). No consent is required for the technical operation of the website.
The configurator page loads an external service (OneSpec) in an embedded frame. It may set its own cookies or use similar technologies, in accordance with its provider’s policy.
You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking may affect the operation of third-party services.
If we introduce analytics or marketing tools, we will ask for your consent before activating them.

support.title: Quality profiles. Digital support. One call away.
support.lead: We work with high-quality multi-chamber profile systems, and every project is managed through a fully digital process — from the first enquiry to installation.
support.p1Text: Multi-chamber profile systems chosen for thermal insulation, durability and a clean, precise finish.
support.p2Text: A dedicated team answers your questions, prepares your quote and stays available after installation.
support.p3Text: Online configuration, digital quotes and orders in a single system: fewer errors, faster answers.
